valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (diceforreadymadegarmentssae) is served under two keys, DSCW PE 10.17 and EGS33321C018.CA PE 10.18, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
